title: Duties of the Press: *köteles*, *kell*
grammar: What the press must and must not do
goal: I can say what the press or an editor must or must not do with *köteles*, *kell* and *nem … -hat/-het*.
I can name the terms of the public sphere (*polgári nyilvánosság*, *sajtóetikai kódex*, *véleménypluralizmus*).
I can write one short sentence about a duty of the press.
